description: This file defines the interface TaxRateService which specifies methods for managing and retrieving tax rate data associated with merchant stores, countries, zones, and tax classes in an e-commerce system.

classes.name: TaxRateService
classes.description: An interface providing methods to retrieve and manage tax rates based on various criteria such as store, country, zone, tax class, and language.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates available for the specified store.

methods.name: listByCountryZoneAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates filtered by country, zone, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: listByCountryStateProvinceAndTaxClass
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates filtered by country, state/province, tax class, store, and language.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Fetches a specific tax rate by its code for a given store.

methods.name: listByStore
methods.description: Retrieves a list of tax rates for a store, considering the specified language.
